ZUG, Switzerland, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ **Lithium Argentina** ” or the “ **Company** ”) ( **TSX: LAR** ) ( **NYSE: LAR** ) will release its third quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.


The Company will hold a webcast and conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Company website at[https://investors.lithium-argentina.com/news-events/events.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gE4wsBo38OkAT4N8Eu8ySP9nDNs3vV0EpEbEjiMdt8GhedP4CDRe3oX2-Ps4Ijoygjs7WKH-CE_jTZgwFC8ciBF31bCXhbHriHnNp44Wnx011eJY-dNiFrT5fTcpY3-4FPnmX91Cvf24sSh_fKoy1LwhyhHXdVUIGo6sLC-DcPkb-NxmXSzCVpwt0hdI-Nb5Jk8Lp3oEDUMZX6SXrBnp5Q==)


**Webcast Details:**
Event Title: Lithium Argentina Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Event Date: November 10, 2026
Start Time: 10:00 AM Eastern time (US and Canada)


**Attendee URL:**[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/520176896](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gE4wsBo38OkAT4N8Eu8ySLrcTgKe9bryFohGNrIm-oZO0Me2Be1CjqsHj84kUkEoYdyk_GuRDj8UcNmAi0X6wyPA8hM_2_87V9nX_s8_fapachB6vrzL2PJfBdq_mzSM55BKRen0xCRCrASLZPLjPv2UTGwQ3S7XLpKm5IroNS0=)

**ABOUT LITHIUM ARGENTINA**


Lithium Argentina, in partnership with Ganfeng, operates the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in Argentina and is advancing additional lithium resources in the region. Lithium Argentina currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE.
